title: Free Printable Word Scrambles by Theme, With Answers
metaDescription: Browse free printable word scrambles for holidays, showers, seasons and animals. Each has a themed word list, optional hints and an answer key to print.
h1: Free Printable Word Scrambles by Theme
intro: Every word scramble below starts with a themed word list, mixes the letters into tiles and gives you an answer key. Pick a topic, add first-letter hints for younger solvers and print up to ten different versions.

sections.heading: Why word scrambles work
body: A scramble asks solvers to hold a few letters in mind and try new orders, which is a quiet kind of spelling practice. It is also a useful warm-up before writing, since students have to look at how a word is built rather than how it sounds.

Every sheet has a writing line for each word, so the answer goes straight under the tiles. The answer key is a separate page. For a shower or party, a table can work on a single sheet together and compare answers.
Hints are optional. Turn on first letters for young children, add a word bank for beginners, or turn both off and see how many an adult can solve in five minutes.

sections.heading: Choosing and customizing
body: The holiday sets, for [Christmas](/word-scramble/christmas/), [Halloween](/word-scramble/halloween/) and [Thanksgiving](/word-scramble/thanksgiving/), are the ones most people reach for in the fall and winter, and the [baby shower](/word-scramble/baby-shower/) and [bridal shower](/word-scramble/bridal-shower/) scrambles are made for party tables.

Every sheet is shuffled by a seed, so a link to a puzzle always shows the same letters. If you print ten versions, each has its own mixing, which is helpful for a classroom where neighbors might peek.
If your topic is not here, open the [word scramble maker](/word-scramble-maker/) and paste any list. It avoids leaving a word in its original order, so there is always something to solve.

faq.a: Yes. Switch on the answer key and each puzzle gets its own answer page.

faq.q: What age are word scrambles for?
faq.a: Children who can spell short words, about seven and up, enjoy them with hints. Older students and adults can try them without hints.
